knowledge.title: Knowledge settings
knowledge.description: Settings section 'knowledge' owned by knowledge. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

default_ttl_hours.description: Lifetime of a memory entry when remember names none.

max_ttl_hours.description: Longest lifetime of a memory entry.

max_chars.description: Largest body of a memory entry.

max_live_per_scope.description: Live (unexpired) entries per scope; remember beyond it fails MEMORY_LIMIT_REACHED.

recall_limit.description: Entries returned by one recall from the private scope.

recall_shared_limit.description: Entries from shared namespaces in one recall; 0 keeps cross-project context off.

namespaces.description: Shared namespaces readable from this scope (* = global).

retention_days.description: Days expired entries are kept before physical deletion.

health_probe_ttl_seconds.description: Cache of the memory health probe used by doctor and hooks.

budget_chars.description: Total size of a memory digest block.

enabled.description: Keep the project graph (nodes and multi-edges).

namespaces.description: Graph namespaces visible from this scope.

max_depth.description: Traversal depth of one graph query.

max_nodes.description: Nodes returned by one graph query.

import_max_bytes.description: Largest canonical import_graph command; also the body limit of its HTTP route.

enabled.description: Enable the code-graph adapter (Serena) for projects of this scope.

argv.description: Command of the code-graph MCP server; {root} is the checkout root.

index_argv.description: Indexing command of the code graph.

ignores.description: Paths the code graph does not index.

serena_schema_pin.description: Expected Serena tool schema digest; a different schema disables the adapter with a doctor warning; empty: no pin.

stale_after_hours.description: An index generation older than this is reported stale in graph answers (freshness).

inject_min_confidence.description: Curated lessons above this confidence are offered to the context as steering.

runtimes.title: Runtimes settings
runtimes.description: Settings section 'runtimes' owned by runtimes. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

allowed.description: Runtime ids role routing may select in this scope; fake is only for tests (--set or test build).

preference.description: Runtime order used when a route names only a model class.

role_routing.description: Route per role: runtime, model or model_class, effort, fallback; empty: choice by class from the model catalog (overlays set personal model pools at the pack level).

role_min_class.description: Lowest model class a role may be routed to.

binaries.description: Executable per runtime id on this host; a missing entry looks up the adapter's default name in PATH.

extra_env_allow.description: Environment variable names passed through to the runtime process per runtime id.

min_class.description: Lowest model class for the route operation new_implementation (nearer levels can only raise it).
Lowest model class for the route operation continuation (nearer levels can only raise it).

resume.description: Session resume policy of a continuation.

min_class.description: Lowest model class for the route operation bounded_fix (nearer levels can only raise it).

resume.description: Session resume policy of a bounded fix.

below_task_class.description: A bounded fix may run below the task's model class.

allowed_extra_paths.description: Paths a bounded fix may touch besides the finding paths without leaving the operation.

test_globs.description: Test paths a bounded fix may add or change.

min_class.description: Lowest model class for the route operation scope_change (nearer levels can only raise it).
Lowest model class for the route operation review (nearer levels can only raise it).
Lowest model class for the route operation final_close (nearer levels can only raise it).
Lowest model class for the route operation research (nearer levels can only raise it).
Lowest model class for the route operation advice (nearer levels can only raise it).
Lowest model class for the route operation auxiliary (nearer levels can only raise it).

allow.description: Capabilities a step may run without (recorded as degraded); empty: none; list of capability ids; never weakens isolation profiles.

copy.description: Copy the client's credential files (0600) into the isolated client home of an attempt.

required.description: Steps must run with the client's user configuration isolated (hooks, plugins, global instructions).

allow_skip_permissions.description: This host may start Claude Code with --dangerously-skip-permissions (only under an isolation profile).

allow_full_access.description: This host may start Codex with sandbox danger-full-access.

script.description: Script of the fake runtime (tests and demos).

max_age_days.description: Age of the model catalog resource after which doctor reports it stale.

keep_reasoning.description: Keep reasoning blocks of the runtime stream in stored transcripts.

on_worker_start.description: Detect installed runtimes and versions when the worker starts.

unknown_model.description: What routing does with a model id that the catalog does not know.

stale_policy.description: What routing does with a capability verification older than stale_after_days.

stale_after_days.description: Age after which a capability verification counts as stale.

overrides.description: Per model id overrides of catalog data (prices, window, tier) or disabling a model.

resume.description: Allow session resume for operations whose admission policy permits it; never forces fresh sessions and ephemeral clients.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Output/CPU-progress silence threshold for suspected_stall or unknown progress; 0 disables suspicion. Silence alone never authorizes cancellation or proves process death; independent deadline, authorized cancellation or verified lease-recovery checks still apply.

result_grace_seconds.description: Time a runtime process may live after its final result before it is stopped.

poll_interval_ms.description: Poll interval of a session for output, CPU progress and cancellation.

max_stream_bytes.description: Combined hard byte ceiling for stdout, stderr, transcript and sidecars of one runtime step; bounded readers stop the step before exceeding it (stream_too_large).

artifacts.title: Artifacts settings
artifacts.description: Settings section 'artifacts' owned by artifacts. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

max_bytes.description: Largest byte upload (staged blob) and file version accepted; the API checks Content-Length against it.

ttl_hours.description: An uploaded blob not consumed by a command within this time is purged by the janitor.

consumed_retention_days.description: Days consumed staged-blob rows are kept for idempotent replays before purge (objects stay).

default_classification.description: Classification of a new file when the request names none.

acknowledge_min_classification.description: Uploads acknowledging content-safety findings must carry at least this classification.

secret_name_globs.description: File name globs (lower case) that block an upload as a probable secret.

max_text_scan_bytes.description: Bytes scanned as text for secrets; larger content gets the info finding CS-NOT-SCANNED.

default_ttl_minutes.description: Lifetime of an access grant to file versions issued for a step or a review.

backend.description: Storage backend id (skm_artifacts.storage_backends) new blobs are written to.

exports.title: Exports settings
exports.description: Settings section 'exports' owned by exports. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

path.description: Explicit Obsidian vault directory on this host; ~ is expanded; absent: probe vault.candidates.

candidates.description: Directories probed in order when vault.path is absent; skm export vault reports the first containing .obsidian.

projects_dir.description: Vault folder that holds project notes.

lock_deadline_seconds.description: Wait for the vault write lock before the export is retried later.

push_interval_seconds.description: Interval of the bound writer-host export service; 0 disables the service (exports run only on command).

plan_archived.description: Write a note when a plan is archived.

run_finished.description: Write a note when a run finishes: never, only failed runs, or all runs.

plans_folder.description: Vault-relative folder of plan notes (no .. segments).

fallback_folder.description: Folder for notes whose project has no folder mapping; ambiguous or invalid mappings block delivery.

max_suffix.description: Highest numeric suffix tried for a free note name.

pending_ttl_days.description: Delivery window of each generation from materialization or requeue; expired notes stay diagnostic, not successful; must not exceed retention_days.

retention_days.description: Days note and receipt history is kept from latest materialization or requeue; purge never shortens the delivery window or deletes vault files.

patterns.description: Repository globs of documents exported to the vault.

vault_subfolder.description: Folder below the project folder that receives exported documents.

max_file_bytes.description: Largest document exported; fixed operation caps for scan entries, file count, total bytes and time also apply to dry-run.

budgets.title: Budgets settings
budgets.description: Settings section 'budgets' owned by execution. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

max_usd.description: Cost ceiling of one run in USD; 0 = unlimited.

max_tokens.description: Fresh input+output tokens of one run; 0 = unlimited.

max_wall_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds of one run; 0 = unlimited.

max_attempts.description: Attempts over all tasks of one run; 0 = unlimited.

max_tool_calls.description: Tool calls reported by runtimes over one run; 0 = unlimited.

max_review_rounds.description: Review rounds over the whole run; 0 = unlimited.

max_usd.description: Cost ceiling of one task; 0 = unlimited.

max_tokens.description: Fresh tokens of one task; 0 = unlimited.

warn_tokens.description: Fresh tokens of one task past which a BUDGET warning event is recorded (nothing stops); 0 = none.

max_attempts.description: Attempts of one task (fresh environments) before the task fails.

max_wall_seconds.description: Active wall-clock seconds of one task; 0 = unlimited.

unknown_usage_policy.description: A step without a usage report: charge the estimate, or stop the run (fail closed).

unknown_usage_charge_tokens.description: Tokens charged for a step without usage when the policy is charge_estimate.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens assumed when reserving a step budget.

block_on_over.description: Readiness becomes not_ready (instead of an advisory) when the budget estimate exceeds the run limits.

learning.title: Learning settings
learning.description: Settings section 'learning' owned by learning. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

enabled.description: Collect learning signals from run events.

client_sessions.description: Also collect signals from interactive client sessions (run_report hook).

candidate_min_n.description: Observations needed to make an ephemeral lesson a candidate.

candidate_min_n_floor.description: Lowest adaptive observation threshold in a low-activity project.

candidate_min_conf.description: Confidence needed to become a candidate.

curated_min_n.description: Observations after which a candidate is flagged ready for curation.

curated_min_conf.description: Confidence after which a candidate is flagged ready for curation (a human decides).

curated_min_passrate.description: Share of passing checks after which a candidate is flagged ready.

deprecate_conf.description: Confidence below which a candidate is deprecated and a curated lesson is flagged for review.

alpha.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Prior successes of the Beta confidence model.

beta.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Prior failures of the Beta confidence model.

volume_k.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Observations at which volume weight reaches one half.

decay_lambda.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Per-day decay factor of old observations.

pathology_window.description: Latest runs inspected for a recurring pathology.

pathology_min_hits.description: Runs of the window a pathology code must occur in to become a candidate.

similar_command.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Similarity at which two commands count as the same.

workflow_relaunch_min.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Relaunches of a workflow that form a relaunch pathology.

reread_min_total.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Reads before the re-read ratio is evaluated.

reread_ratio_max.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Share of repeated reads above which re-reading is flagged.

error_loop_info_len.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Repeated errors that give an info error-loop signal.

error_loop_attention_len.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Repeated errors that give an attention error-loop signal.

noop_min_tools.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Tool calls without a change that form a no-op pathology.

cache_hit_low.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Prompt-cache hit rate below which a cache signal is raised.

cache_miss_min_tokens.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Uncached input tokens needed before the cache signal counts.

retrieval_in_share.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Share of input tokens spent on retrieval above which it is flagged.

retrieval_repeated_min.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Repeated retrievals of the same source that count.

chars_per_token.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Characters per token assumed by detectors without usage data.

static_min_msgs.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Messages before the static-session detector applies.

static_window_share.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Share of the window without progress that counts as static.

static_max_tools.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Tool calls below which a long session counts as static.

fanout_min_agents.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Delegated agents that form a fan-out signal.

fanout_max_files.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Changed files at most for the fan-out signal to apply.

extra_runner_patterns.description: Extra regular expressions recognizing test or build runner commands.

shortlist_threshold.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Similarity from which candidates are shortlisted for consolidation.

trigger_high.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Trigger similarity that proposes a merge.

action_high.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Action similarity that proposes a merge.

action_low.description: Heuristic, not calibrated on field data (legacy analyst admits it). Action similarity below which candidates are kept apart.

interval_seconds.description: Interval of the confidence recompute job.

workspace.title: Workspace settings
workspace.description: Settings section 'workspace' owned by workspace. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

locale.description: Default human language of reports and agent summaries in this workspace.

default_project.description: Project slug the CLI selects when `skm use` names only the workspace.

verify_on_resolve.description: Re-check remotes and HEAD of a checkout binding every time it is resolved for execution.

stale_after_days.description: A binding not verified for this many days is reported as stale by doctor.

marker_path.description: Checkout-relative path of the marker file that binds a checkout to its project (no .. segments).

allowed_remote_hosts.description: Git hosts repositories may be registered from; empty list = any host (unlimited).

offline_after_seconds.description: A worker without a heartbeat for this long is marked offline.

events.title: Events settings
events.description: Settings section 'events' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

max_attempts.description: Delivery attempts of one outbox message to one destination before it becomes dead.

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline of one subscriber or hook delivery.

backoff_seconds.description: Back-off base: attempt n waits min(backoff_seconds * 2^(n-1), backoff_max_seconds).

backoff_max_seconds.description: Upper bound of the delivery back-off.

visibility_timeout_seconds.description: A claimed outbox row not acknowledged within this time is claimable again (crashed relay).

delivered_retention_hours.description: Delivered outbox rows and their consumer receipts older than this are purged by the janitor task outbox_gc; pending, failed and dead rows are never purged automatically.

planning.title: Planning settings
planning.description: Settings section 'planning' owned by planning. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

require_acceptance_links.description: Every acceptance criterion must be bound to a check or to review; otherwise an error finding.

warn_unknown_skills.description: Report skills that the extensions registry does not know as warnings.

warn_unknown_models.description: Report route models unknown to the runtime catalog as warnings.

heavy_text_kb.description: Size of a text field above which validation warns that it is heavy.

external_checks.description: Run trusted validator plugins registered for planning validation.

external_failure.description: What a failing or invalid validator plugin counts as.

code_suffixes.description: File suffixes that count as code for the write_scope_no_tests finding.

heavy_check_markers.description: Substrings marking a heavy check command for the check_cadence finding (repository-specific; empty by default).

max_supersede_chain.description: Longest chain of superseding decisions followed while resolving a cross-plan reference.

design_audit.description: Required: a run starts only with a readiness report that includes the semantic audit step.

route_class.description: route.class written into a new item by templates and the structured editor.

route_effort.description: route.effort written into a new item.

review_mode.description: review.mode written into a new item (waived needs a reason in the item).

max_document_bytes.description: Largest specification document a draft may hold.

max_open.description: Open drafts per plan; opening one more fails with ALREADY_EXISTS (details open_drafts, limit).

prefix.description: Prefix of plan aliases allocated per project (PLAN7).

tree_depth.description: Levels printed by `skm plan show --tree`: 1 phases, 2 with items, 3 with units.

extensions.title: Extensions settings
extensions.description: Settings section 'extensions' owned by extensions. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

enabled.description: Installed packs active in this scope (accumulates over levels; the core pack is always active).

versions.description: Version constraint per pack slug (for example ">=1.2,<2"); absent: newest active version.

search_dirs.description: Host directories scanned by `skm ext install --from-dirs` for pack folders.

priority.description: Override of pack priority (higher wins on resource and pack-level config conflicts).

pinned.description: Resource "<kind>:<key>" -> digest or exact version used instead of the newest active version.

on_incompatible.description: What install does with a resource that fails compatibility rules.

allowed_licenses.description: SPDX licenses accepted for installed resources.

max_skill_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of one skill body above which install reports SKILL_TOO_LARGE.

max_steering_tokens.description: Estimated tokens of one steering resource above which install reports it.

extra_known_tools.description: Tool names accepted in skill allowed-tools besides the built-in list.

max_archive_bytes.description: Largest pack archive accepted by install.

max_archive_files.description: Most files in one pack archive.

sync_on_start.description: Register built-in and search_dirs packs when the process starts.

role_profiles.description: Agent profile resource key per role; absent: the default profile key of the role (for example executor-transparent at project level).

check_interval_days.description: Days between upstream checks of resources with provenance strategy notify; 0 disables.

storage.title: Storage settings
storage.description: Settings section 'storage' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

statement_timeout_ms.description: statement_timeout set on every connection; long queries fail with BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.

lock_timeout_ms.description: lock_timeout set on every connection; 0 waits forever.

idle_in_transaction_timeout_ms.description: Server-side limit of an idle open transaction (SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout); 0 disables it.

max_attempts.description: Attempts of one command transaction on serialization failure (40001/40P01) before SERIALIZATION_FAILURE.

backoff_ms.description: Base back-off between transaction retries; doubled per attempt with full jitter.

ttl_hours.description: Lifetime of idempotency receipts; the janitor service purges older receipts.

modules.title: Modules settings
modules.description: Settings section 'modules' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

enabled.description: Enable the optional knowledge module (memory, lessons, graph).
Enable the optional learning module (lesson candidates from runs).
Enable the optional exports module (Markdown and Obsidian projections).

checks.title: Checks settings
checks.description: Settings section 'checks' owned by execution. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

base_allowlist.description: Environment variables every check process receives (plus the definition's env_allow).

max_bytes.description: Bytes of stdout/stderr captured per check; beyond it the stream is cut and marked [truncated].

summary_chars.description: Characters of the redacted output tail kept as the check summary.

max_seconds.description: Upper bound of a check's timeout_s (execution.checks.default_timeout_seconds applies when the definition names none).

allowed.description: Checks of kind shell may run (they also need risk_ack in the definition).

background.title: Background services settings
background.description: Settings section 'background' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

interval_ms.description: Idle interval of the outbox_relay service between passes that found no work. Delivers committed outbox messages to subscribers and hook destinations.

batch_size.description: Outbox rows claimed by one relay pass.

max_lag_seconds.description: Readiness warns when the oldest undelivered outbox row is older than this.

interval_ms.description: Runs the janitor tasks idempotency_gc, staging_gc, intent_expiry, outbox_gc and exports_purge.
Idle interval of the scheduler service between passes that found no work. Dispatches ScheduleReadyTasks.
Idle interval of the lease_sweeper service between passes that found no work. Dispatches ExpireLeases and marks silent workers offline.
Idle interval of the timeout_enforcer service between passes that found no work. Dispatches EnforceTimeouts.
Idle interval of the stall_detector service between passes that found no work. Dispatches DetectStalls.
Idle interval of the autopilot service between passes that found no work. Dispatches AutopilotTick for projects with the autopilot enabled.
Idle interval of the memory_expirer service between passes that found no work. Dispatches ExpireMemory (module knowledge).

access.title: Access settings
access.description: Settings section 'access' owned by access. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

default_ttl_days.description: Lifetime of a new API token when the request names none; 0 means no expiry.

max_ttl_days.description: Longest lifetime a token may get; 0 means unlimited.

worker_ttl_hours.description: Lifetime of tokens issued to worker principals (G20); `skm worker register --rotate` issues a new one.

worker_rotate_before_hours.description: A worker rotates its token this long before expiry.

rotation_grace_minutes.description: The previous token stays valid this long after a rotation (in-flight requests).

assignment_permissions.description: Permissions of assignment-scoped tokens handed to runtimes: reads on ancestors of the run, writes in the run only; never the worker protocol (worker.claim).

assignment_ttl_slack_seconds.description: Assignment-scoped tokens handed to a runtime (MCP) expire this long after the lease expires.

record_allowed.description: Write audit records for allowed mutations (denials are always recorded; queries are never audited).

touch_interval_seconds.description: At most one last_used_at update per token within this interval; 0 updates on every request.

context.title: Context settings
context.description: Settings section 'context' owned by context. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

max_total_tokens.description: Upper bound of the estimated tokens of one assembled context (also bounded by window_fraction of the model window).

window_fraction.description: Share of the routed model's context window a context may use.

allow_third_party.description: Resources of third_party packs may enter contexts.

inherit_user_global.description: Runtimes may load the user's global client instructions (for example ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md); the role profile field inherit_user_global can only narrow it (G41).

max_classification_for_runtime.description: Most sensitive file classification that may be sent to an external runtime.

store_host_block_content.description: Store host block text in the final manifest artifact (otherwise digests and locators only).

output_language.description: Language of human-facing text in role results; empty uses workspace.locale.

token_estimator.description: Built-in heuristic, or the qualified key of an enabled token_estimator plugin; both ends must use the same estimator id.

core.description: Token budget of core blocks (constraints, role and task contract, requirements).

supporting.description: Token budget of supporting blocks (steering, skills, decisions, review feedback, history).

retrieval.description: Token budget of retrieval blocks (materials, repository files, research documents, memory).

max_tokens.description: Largest single block; a longer source is truncated with a reason in the manifest.

budget_tokens.description: Token budget of embedded skill bodies within the supporting class.

max_mode.description: Ceiling of the role profile's skills_mode: none, allowlist (named skills only) or auto (also matching triggers).

max_count.description: Most skills embedded in one context (after selection, by reason priority).

mode.description: Repository instruction files in contexts: none; constraints: only their constraint sections; full: whole files (blocks are marked untrusted).

max_bytes.description: Total bytes of repository instruction files; beyond it blocks are excluded with a reason.

max_files.description: Repository instruction files read per step (symlinks are refused).

files.description: Instruction file names looked up per directory; the order matters (the first existing file wins).

max_steps.description: Earlier steps of the attempt summarized into the history block.

enabled.description: Add a memory block from the knowledge module (requires modules.knowledge.enabled).

top_k.description: Memory entries in the memory block.

max.description: Work paths listed in the task contract; more are summarized by directory.

max_bytes.description: Total bytes the host reads for host blocks of one step.

file_max_bytes.description: Bytes read from one host file.

extra.description: Additional rules appended to the task contract of every step (accumulate over levels).

top_sources.description: Largest sources listed in the context budget report.

kind.description: command | filesystem | mcp_stdio | key of a research_source plugin component

sources.description: Research sources by id (host machine levels only: argv starts processes); projects can only disable a source.

disabled_sources.description: Source ids not used in this scope.

fs_roots_allow.description: Absolute host directories filesystem sources may read outside checkouts.

url_deny.description: Host globs whose documents are dropped from research results (private networks by default).

allow_deep.description: Queries may use depth deep (deep_research tier).

max_documents.description: Documents kept from one research query.

min_documents.description: Documents after which the ladder stops asking more expensive tiers.

enabled.description: Reuse cached results of the same query digest, scope and permissions.

default_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of a cached result when the source names none.

max_ttl_seconds.description: Longest lifetime of a cached result.

ui.title: Web UI settings
ui.description: Settings section 'ui' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

open_browser.description: `skm local up` opens the web UI in the default browser.

stale_after_seconds.description: Time after which displayed data is marked stale when the live connection is lost.

tree_depth.description: Levels of the plan tree expanded by default (phase, item, unit).

live_stream.description: Open the live step stream automatically on the run page.

logging.title: Logging settings
logging.description: Settings section 'logging' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

level.description: Minimum level of operational logs on this host.

format.description: Log line format: JSON lines (default) or human text for local debugging.

file.description: Log file path; absent (default) writes to stderr. ~ and ${state_dir} are expanded.

redact_patterns.description: Extra regular expressions whose matches are masked in logs, events and errors (secrets are always masked).

retention_days.description: Days to keep rotated log files under state_dir/logs; 0 keeps them forever.

detail.description: Diagnostic volume of this process: debug adds only typed safe metadata (IDs, counts, durations, digests and closed codes), never DTO/payload previews or raw content. Source masks apply before projection and Redactor after it; lifecycle events and audit are written in both modes.

file_max_bytes.description: Rotate the log file when it reaches this size.

file_backups.description: Rotated log files kept next to the current one (retention_days applies as well).

hooks.title: Hooks settings
hooks.description: Settings section 'hooks' owned by integrations. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

subscriptions.description: Hook subscriptions by id: class, kind (webhook, command, event_sink), execution_location (control_plane, host), event types, target, timeout_ms, retry, failure_policy (deny, warn, retry). A nearer level may switch an inherited subscription off with enabled=false.

allow_http_loopback.description: Allow http:// webhook URLs on loopback addresses (local testing); https is required otherwise.

allow_private_networks.description: Allow webhook URLs resolving to private or link-local networks.

max_response_bytes.description: Bytes of a webhook response read before the connection is closed.

max_subscriptions_per_event.description: Subscriptions one event may be delivered to; more is a configuration error reported by doctor.

trusted.description: Command subscriptions trusted on this host: id -> digest of the trusted command target; written by `skm hooks trust`.

max_parallel.description: Host subscriptions executed at the same time by one process.

spool_max_items.description: Host deliveries kept in the local retry spool; 0 disables the spool (retry then behaves like warn).

execution.title: Execution settings
execution.description: Settings section 'execution' owned by execution. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

profile.description: Workflow resource used for tasks whose work_kind has no entry in profile_by_work_kind.

request_workflow.description: Workflow of ad-hoc review runs started by execution.request_review (G5).

max_rounds.description: Review rounds per task output chain before escalation.

final_correction.description: After the last allowed review round, allow one final correction limited to confirmed blockers.

accept_findings_only.description: Rework may address only triaged findings (fix_now); other changes count as deviations.

attention_policy.description: Verdict attention: triage the findings automatically, or ask the owner.

strategy.description: per_task: review mode from the plan; risk_scored: tasks with review mode self get a reviewer when the risk score passes threshold.

grouping.description: none: every task output is reviewed on its own; groups: tasks of a group are reviewed together and blockers become follow-up tasks.

followups_max.description: Follow-up tasks created from one group review.

solo_paths.description: Path globs whose changes are always reviewed on their own, even with grouping.

audit_scope.description: A re-review audits only the corrected findings, or the full output.

profile.description: Agent profile resource of the reviewer role (security for the security review profile, G19).

security_on_risk.description: A task whose risk features include security gets an additional review with the security profile.

threshold.description: Risk score from which a self-reviewed task gets an independent review.

patterns.description: Path globs of path-based risk features (shared is project-specific, empty by default).

diff_lines.description: Changed lines past which the diff_size feature counts.

critical.description: Features that require an independent review regardless of the score.

max_age_seconds.description: Age after which a readiness report is stale even when its inputs did not change.

semantic_audit_allowed.description: ValidateForExecution may request a semantic plan audit by the advisor through the plan-audit workflow; the permission is instance-controlled.

require_coverage.description: Readiness is not_ready when a requirement has no acceptance criterion bound to a check or review.

max_units.description: Tasks of one run executing at the same time (also bounded by worker.capacity).

max_runs_per_project.description: Runs of one project in status running at the same time.

waiting_counts.description: Tasks waiting for a human occupy a parallel slot.

max_rounds.description: Rework rounds after failed checks or manual verdicts; review rework uses execution.review.max_rounds.

max_findings.description: Findings in one fix brief; blockers are never left out (more blockers raise the limit), the rest is referenced by the full report artifact.

max_finding_chars.description: Characters of one finding in the fix brief (message, location, suggestion); longer text is cut and marked truncated.

max_inline_evidence_bytes.description: Evidence bytes inlined per finding; larger evidence is passed as a file version reference.

max_total_bytes.description: Bytes of one fix brief; beyond it truncated=true and the full report is referenced.

phase_review.description: Review of a whole phase at its phase_gate stage: never, when a task of the phase passed the risk threshold, always (G19).

on_exhausted.description: After budgets.task.max_attempts: open a decision request for the owner, or fail the task.

max_result_retries.description: Repeats of a role step whose result stays invalid after form-only repair.

max_infra_retries.description: Repeats of a step after a retryable runtime error (rate limit, crash) before escalation.

error_retries.description: Repeats of a check whose run ended in state error (not failed).

default_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout of a command check whose definition names none.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Output-silence threshold for suspected_stall only; 0 disables suspicion. A silent check is stopped only by its authoritative check.timeout/wall deadline or explicit authorized cancellation, with process identity checked.

reuse_green.description: Reuse a passed check result whose fingerprint (output digest, check digest, env manifest) is unchanged.

reverify.description: The triager re-checks blocker findings against the output before rework.

repro_timeout_seconds.description: Time limit of a reproduction command run by the triager.

outside_policy.description: Changes outside the write set: recorded as a deviation for acceptance, or block acceptance.

enabled.description: Whether the advisor role answers decision requests at all.

max_rounds.description: Advice rounds per task, all triggers together.

human_gate.description: Question categories always sent to the owner; union of all levels including the default, so no level can remove a category (G27).

min_confidence.description: Minimum advisor confidence to apply an answer automatically; the strictest level wins.

question_policy.description: Blocking executor question: ask the advisor within authority, queue for the owner, apply documented defaults, or deny.

max_questions_per_task.description: Decision requests one task may open before it escalates to the owner.

category_audience.description: Audience per decision category (G27): advisor or owner; per category the stricter value (owner) wins over farther explicit levels.

on_expired.description: A decision request past its deadline keeps waiting or fails the task.

members.description: Route selectors runtime[/model] of consilium advisors; fewer than 2 disables the consilium.

aggregation.description: How consilium answers combine (v2.0: majority only; disagreement beyond it escalates to the owner).

max_resume_context_tokens.description: A resumed session whose accumulated context exceeds this starts fresh with a handoff instead (G7).

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of an assignment lease without renewal.

renew_every_seconds.description: How often a worker renews its lease (must be below ttl/2).

reap_wait_seconds.description: How long an attempt whose runtime was running when its lease expired waits for the worker of the same host to confirm the reap before a new attempt starts (rule L2).

capability_wait_seconds.description: A ready task no online worker can serve (labels, environment kind, capabilities) waits this long before a WAITING diagnostic.

recheck_seconds.description: Interval of re-checking material availability for tasks BLOCKED_BY_MATERIAL.

step_wall_seconds.description: Ceiling on one role step; 0 uses timeouts.role_wall_seconds or none.

stage_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit of non-agent stages; agent steps use step_wall_seconds and role_wall_seconds; 0 = none.

idle_seconds.description: No-progress observation threshold for suspected_stall; 0 disables suspicion. Missing output/events is not process death and alone never authorizes cancellation, restart or destructive recovery.

hung_after_seconds.description: A stage past its deadline or a lease heartbeat older than this is classified hung.

stall_repeat_n.description: The same command repeated this many times counts as no progress for the stall rule; 0 disables it.

wait_grace_seconds.description: Grace after a waiting deadline before a stage counts as suspected_stall.

run_warn_seconds.description: Active run time after which run health reports a long-running warning.

recover.description: Recovery mode after a health finding: notify, stop_only or resume. Destructive action additionally requires an expired authoritative deadline, explicit authorized cancellation or verified lease recovery and current process identity; suspicion or silence alone only notifies.

max_recoveries.description: Circuit breaker (G10): automatic recoveries of one run within window_seconds; one more pauses the run and opens a decision request.

window_seconds.description: Window of the recovery circuit breaker.

grace_seconds.description: Grace after SIGINT and after SIGTERM before SIGKILL of a runtime process group.

diagnostic_snapshot.description: Before killing a stalled runtime process group, save a diagnostic snapshot (process tree, last output) as evidence (G10).

on_error.description: Override of the retry table per runtime error class: action and maximum repeats.

fallback_routes.description: Routes tried in order when the error class action is fallback.

provider_wait_max_seconds.description: Longest wait for a provider rate limit or quota reset before escalation.

budget_total_max.description: Stage repeats over the whole run.

branch.description: Branch accepted tasks are integrated into; {run} expands to the run alias.

strategy.description: How an accepted output enters the integration branch: squash (one commit with the accepted tree), rebase or merge of the output chain.

commit_mode.description: final_only: one commit per accepted task; implementation_and_fixes: the first output is an implementation commit and every rework output a fix commit.

base.description: Ref the integration branch starts from when it does not exist yet.

exclude_paths.description: Globs never committed (runtime artifacts, transcripts, evidence); the sealer also excludes the runtime's declared artifact paths.

commit_scope.description: Scope of commit subjects type(scope): ...; empty omits the scope.

rerun_checks.description: Rerun checks marked rerun_after_integration after each integration.

slot_poll_seconds.description: Wait before a worker asks again for a busy integration slot.

slot_wait_max_seconds.description: Longest wait for the integration slot before the stage fails with SLOT_BUSY.

kind.description: Kind of attempt environment: a git worktree of the bound checkout, the checkout itself (one attempt at a time), or a clone managed by the worker.

clone_depth.description: History depth of a managed clone; 0 clones the full history.

selector.description: Labels a worker must all have (worker.labels) to claim tasks of this scope; label or label=value; accumulates over levels.

on_task_failed.description: continue: independent tasks go on and the run ends failed; stop: pause the run at the first failed task.

allowed_keys.description: Instance restriction intersected with the fixed semantic run-reconfiguration allowlist; trailing .* restricts matching groups but never authorizes arbitrary workflow, security or acceptance changes.

context_tokens.description: Average context tokens per role used by the readiness budget estimate.

mode.description: When the scout stage runs: never, when the item route sets the scout flag, or for every task.

kill_switch.description: Stop issuing assignments and pause running runs in this scope (live; lock it at instance to hold it).

min_version.description: Workers older than this version are refused at claim with CLIENT_TOO_OLD.

allowed.description: Whether accepted results may be carried forward to a run of a newer revision (manual only).

command.description: argv that regenerates generated files of the project, run in the attempt environment before checks.

check_command.description: argv that verifies generated files are fresh (exit 0).

paths.description: Globs of generated files: writes there by the executor are allowed only through generation.command.

enabled.description: Debug mode: verbose step logs and DEBUG markers in run events.

policy.description: When a task gets a research stage: always, when its research need is required/optional, or never.

allowed.description: Whether the autopilot service may run at all in this instance.

enabled.description: Whether the autopilot continues the approved queue of this project.

queue.description: Approved plan references (aliases or ids) the autopilot may start runs for, in order.

max_runs.description: Runs one autopilot session may start.

max_wall_seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds of one autopilot session.

max_no_progress_runs.description: Runs in a row without an accepted task before AUTOPILOT stops.

max_auto_decisions.description: Advisor-answered questions one session may accept before stopping for the owner.

quota_wait_max_seconds.description: Longest wait for a provider quota reset before the autopilot stops.

accept_advisories.description: Start runs whose readiness is ready_with_advisories.

max_waiting_runs.description: Runs of the queue waiting for a human at the same time before the autopilot stops starting new ones.

max_no_improvement_rounds.description: Rework rounds in a row whose checks and review do not improve before the autopilot stops (S-49).

max_consecutive_failures.description: Runs in a row ended by an infrastructure failure (runtime crash, worker lost, environment error) before the autopilot stops (G8).

stop_on.description: Optional stop conditions added to the mandatory ones (no work, owner needed, budget, repeated blocker, integrity violation, checkout ownership lost, no progress, decisions exceeded) (G8).

plugins.title: Plugins settings
plugins.description: Settings section 'plugins' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

allowed.description: Plugin ids (skm.plugins entry points) that may be imported; order decides conflicts; empty: no plugin is loaded.

control_plane_allowed.description: Plugin ids that may load in the API server process, where the database and secrets are reachable; must also be allowed.

override_builtin.description: Component keys <kind>:<key> that a plugin may register although a built-in component has the same key.

required.description: Plugin ids that must load; a failure stops the process start with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE (exit 3).

worker.title: Worker settings
worker.description: Settings section 'worker' owned by execution. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

capacity.description: Assignments this host's worker executes at the same time.

disk_min_bytes.description: Free disk below which the worker stops claiming (doctor reports it).

labels.description: Free labels advertised in worker capabilities and matched by assignment requirements.

retain.description: Keep attempt worktrees after the attempt ends: never, only failed, always.

retain_days.description: Days retained environments are kept before cleanup; 0 = until manual cleanup.

kinds.description: Environment kinds this worker provides; the scheduler matches execution.environment.kind against it (existing_checkout must be listed explicitly).

available.description: Isolation profiles this host provides (detected at worker start; listing an unavailable one is reported).

default_profile.description: Profile used when the role's policy profile does not require one; none is never chosen automatically.

image.description: Container image with the runtime CLIs, pinned by digest.

network.description: Pre-created docker network with the egress proxy used for network mode allowlist; absent: allowlist is unavailable in containers.

author_name.description: Author and committer name of commits made by SKM.

author_email.description: Author and committer email of commits made by SKM.

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout of an ordinary git call.

long_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout of git calls marked long (clone, fetch, push, gc).

min_version.description: Oldest git accepted on this host (worktree and sparse features).

remote_env_allowlist.description: Environment variables passed to network git calls.

use_credential_helper.description: Let network git calls use the host's credential helper (never interactive).

retain_local_hours.description: Hours local transcript originals are kept after upload; 0 deletes them right after upload.

integrations.title: Integrations settings
integrations.description: Settings section 'integrations' owned by integrations. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

targets.description: Clients whose native files a projection writes in checkouts of this project.

permission_profile.description: Permission level rendered into client settings; trusted_full_access needs integrations.trusted_full_access.allowed on the host.

bundles.description: Integration bundles (agent packs) projected into the clients.

conflict_suffix.description: Suffix of the file written next to a user-modified managed file.

allowed.description: This host may receive trusted_full_access client settings.

enabled.description: Write managed instruction blocks into client instruction files.

project_text.description: Project text placed in the instructions.project managed block.

enabled.description: Project skills into client skill folders.

include_core.description: Include the skills of the core pack.

presets.description: Named skill sets (pack presets) expanded before include/exclude.

include.description: Skill keys (or pack/key) projected into client skill folders.

exclude.description: Skill keys removed from the projected set.

include_skm.description: Add the skm MCP server to client MCP settings.

servers.description: MCP servers written into client MCP settings; environment values only as secret references.

target.description: Target resident tokens of the first turn in a client.

warn.description: Resident tokens of the first turn above which the budget check warns (owner verdict needed).

fraction.description: Share of the context window the client's skill listing may take.

context_window.description: Context window assumed for the skill listing share.

mode.description: Mode per client hook surface evaluated by skm-hook.

changelog_files.description: Files the changelog_gate surface expects to change with a release-relevant commit.

timeout_ms.description: Deadline of one skm-hook evaluation; on expiry the client gets the fail-safe answer of the surface.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of the cached hook policy on the host; 0 disables the cache.

policy.title: Policy settings
policy.description: Settings section 'policy' owned by policy. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

default_profile.description: Permission profile (resource policy-profile) used when a role profile names none.

profiles.description: Custom permission profiles by id (urn:skm:policy:profile:v1, also from packs); an id may not shadow a built-in profile.

restrictions.description: Permission layers (partial profiles) narrowing the effective permissions; layers of all levels apply together (conjunction).

safe_dirs.description: Host directories outside worktrees that read-only tool calls may access (e.g. a shared cache).

profile.description: Permission profile evaluated by client hooks of interactive sessions (skm-hook).

network.description: Network ceiling of agent steps: any, only network_allowlist hosts, or none.

network_allowlist.description: Host patterns reachable when the network ceiling is allowlist; empty forbids every host. Use network=any for unrestricted access.

shell.description: Whether checks of kind shell and shell tool calls may run at all.

external_effects.description: External effect kinds runs may perform (still subject to approval rules).

isolation_profiles.description: Isolation profiles steps may use; none (unconfined) is excluded by default and also needs policy.host.allow_unconfined.

commands_denylist.description: Command prefixes always refused in agent tool calls and checks (accumulates over levels).

required_for.description: External effects that need an approval of a human (accumulates: a nearer level can only add).

ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of an approval of a tool intent.

single_use.description: An approval authorizes one execution only.

proposal_ttl_seconds.description: A proposed tool intent not approved within this time expires.

risk.description: Risk class per external effect kind (drives approval and audit detail).

allowed.description: Access capabilities that nearer levels may grant to steps; empty: none.

granted.description: Access capabilities granted to steps of this scope; effective = granted ∩ allowed.

operations.description: Operations whose rule is task_authority that tasks of this scope may perform (for example git_discard).

mode.description: Interactive auto-approval of client tool calls by `skm hook`: strict allows read-only commands, permissive all but the denylist, off disables auto-approval (the client asks the human).

allow_unconfined.description: This host may run steps under profiles with requires_host_flag (trusted-full-access) and isolation none.

max_entries.description: Entries of the host fact cache used by hook evaluation.

max_glob_matches.description: Paths one glob of a rule may expand to while facts are collected.

api.title: HTTP API settings
api.description: Settings section 'api' owned by platform. Every leaf carries x-skm metadata read by the settings registry.

bind.description: Listen address host:port of skm serve.

allowed_hosts.description: Accepted Host headers; empty: derived from api.bind for loopback (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1] with the port).

min_client_version.description: Clients sending an older SKM-Client-Version get CLIENT_TOO_OLD.

max_response_bytes.description: Largest JSON response; larger queries must paginate.

trusted.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers from a reverse proxy.

size.description: Threads executing bus calls of the API (bootstrap database.pool_max_size must be at least it plus enabled background services and 3).

grace_seconds.description: Time to finish requests and stop services on shutdown.

origins.description: Browser origins allowed by CORS (null origin is always refused); empty: no CORS headers.

max_body_bytes.description: Largest JSON request body; byte uploads use artifacts.upload.max_bytes.

timeout_seconds.description: Request timeout of the HTTP client (http access mode; long polls use their own deadline).

default_limit.description: Page size when limit is omitted.

heartbeat_seconds.description: Heartbeat comment interval of idle SSE streams.

poll_ms.description: Fallback poll of the event journal when no NOTIFY arrived (missed notifications, several API processes).

max_streams_per_token.description: Open event streams per token; more fail with 429 TOO_MANY_STREAMS.

queue_size.description: Bounded queue per stream; an overflowing stream is closed and the client reconnects with its cursor.

batch_ms.description: Batching window of live step output frames.

buffer_events.description: Live step-stream events kept in memory per attempt for reconnects.

max_response_tokens.description: Maximum estimated tokens of one MCP response; truncation uses the shared TokenEstimator, no separate chars-per-token setting.

schema_check_interval_seconds.description: How often skm serve compares skm_core.schema_migrations with the known schema version; a newer schema turns readiness to fail (SCHEMA_TOO_NEW).

max_long_polls.description: Concurrent long-poll claim requests per API process; beyond it a claim returns NOTHING_TO_CLAIM at once.
